textarea.tan17dc5377:
Bluetest AB is a Gothenburg based company, with global presence, that develops state of the art test systems to verify performance of wireless devices. We are world leading in what we do and innovation is one of the fundamental keys in our business. We are working closely with our customers, among them the largest mobile phone manufacturers in the world, and we follow the telecommunication industry carefully. Together we work towards the most reliable and trustworthy Over-the-Air (OTA) test solution on the market. We have installed over 500 OTA reverberation test systems worldwide over the past 25 years.

We believe that the deep technical competence of our employees, combined with a culture of openness, participation and responsiveness can help our engineering customers deal with an explosion of wireless complexity with simple, trustworthy, test systems. Our market is global, so although we are small, we are an international team structured for world-wide customer engagement as well as building bridges with academia, standards organizations and research institutions. As we expand the applications of our technology, we are building a long-term organization with a rewarding environment for employees who are collaborating on creative solutions and delivering consistent profitability.
textarea.ta5008de90:
From day one, you're in expert hands. We tailor training to your team so you're up and running quickly, and our planned upgrades and maintenance keep your system current as your needs evolve. We provide service paths that extend the life and capability of your RTS, and stay with you well beyond installation.

We help you get unstuck fast. When something needs resolving, you're connected directly to the engineers who designed and use these systems themselves. No helpdesk, no ticket queues, just the right person from the first call. Plus, you can monitor and control measurements from anywhere with Flow Touch, retrieve updated license files through our customer web, and choose simple calibration options, including a quick self-calibration or off-site calibration files when a VNA is not available.

Our support spans regions and use cases, from IoT and Wi-Fi to base stations and automotive, with systems operating in more than 40 countries. The goal is simple. Keep your lab productive, your data trustworthy, and your next decision clear.
